image_description: A close-up, slightly high-angle shot of an Asian man with glasses and a zebra-print scarf holding an open menu. The menu is the primary subject in the foreground, featuring Japanese text organized in columns with red accents. The background shows a blurred restaurant interior with wooden shelves and stacked bowls.

artifact_observations.reasoning: While the text mimics the visual density and structure of Japanese characters, closer inspection reveals that individual characters lack precise stroke definition and may be nonsensical or 'melted' together, a common AI artifact in rendering dense non-Latin scripts.
The zebra pattern on the scarf has slight inconsistencies in stripe width and edge sharpness where it folds, appearing slightly painted rather than woven.
The thumb holding the bottom left corner of the menu appears somewhat fused with the paper edge, lacking a distinct nail bed and clear separation between skin and paper.
